patch_description: The current candidate (32 params: tilt, twist, phase, break_ry, break_rz) achieves the same perfect accuracy as the simpler 20-param version (tilt, twist, phase only) from a prior generation, but with lower parameter efficiency (0.03 vs 0.05) and higher depth/gate count. Since the scoring rewards parameter economy and the symmetry-breaking terms provide no measurable accuracy gain over the pure collective-spin model, we remove the `break_ry`/`break_rz` single-qubit correction terms on qubit 0. This reduces per-block distinct params from 5 to 3, cutting total circuit params from 30 to 18 (32 total to 20 total), while preserving the full-strength collective tilt/twist/phase structure that already delivers 100% train/val/test accuracy. This directly optimizes the parameter-economy objective without sacrificing convergence speed, since the removed terms were likely redundant with the permutation-symmetric readout (mean of Z-Z correlators is itself permutation-invariant, making per-qubit symmetry breaking less useful).
